title: Charli xcx Books Cameo in Martin Scorsese Thriller Starring Leonardo DiCaprio and Jennifer Lawrence
summary: The singer will reportedly appear in What Happens at Night, the follow-up to the legendary director's Oscar-nominated Killers of the Flower Moon.
contentText:
Charli xcx ‘s great Hollywood adventure will reportedly reach a new peak with her next role: a cameo in Martin Scorsese’s upcoming psychological thriller What Happens at Night . According to Variety , after landing the legendary director for a cameo on the cover of her recent Music, Fashion, Film album, Charli will reportedly appear in an unspecified role in the Oscar-winner’s upcoming movie alongside stars Leonardo DiCaprio and Jennifer Lawrence.

The Gothic psychological drama from Apple and StudioCanal reportedly concerns a married American couple who travel to a small European town to adopt a baby, where they realize they may not know each other as well as they thought as they struggle to claim the child.

At press time a spokesperson for Charli had not returned Billboard ‘s request to confirm the singer’s role in the film that will also feature Mads Mikkelsen ( Another Round ), Patricia Clarkson ( She Said ) and Jared Harris ( Foundation ).

The booking would continue Charli’s run of big screen projects, which has spanned seven movies over the past two years, including the just-released Netflix eco-terror thriller Sacrifice , in which she plays vapid pop star Mother Nature, who rats out fellow performer Daughter Nature (Ambika Mod) in the midst of a swanky environmental gathering in a cave on a remote Greek island.

Following a performance of her sexy environmental anthem “Supernature” — which was written by Gener8ion — Charli and the rest of the swanks at the event, including vain action movie star Mike Tyler (Chris Evans), the world’s richest Man, Ben Bracken (Vincent Cassel) and his glamorous wife, pop star Gloria Bracken (Salma Hayek), are taken hostage by a crazed ecological group that believes the end of the world is coming. Rapper Yung Lean also appears in the film as the brother of lead eco terrorist Joan (Anya Taylor-Joy).

That role comes on the heels of her parts in the dramas Erupcja , 100 Nights of Hero , The Gallerist , Faces of Death , I Want Your Sex and The Moment , a tour mockumentary in which she played a heightened version of herself.

What Happens at Night is the follow-up to Scorsese’s Oscar-nominated 2023 drama Killers of the Flower Moon ; no release date has been announced for the movie.

Charli is gearing up for the final 2026 date of her Music, Fashion, Film tour, which is slated to wind-down on Friday night (Oct. 23) at the MGM Grand Garden Arena in Las Vegas. The singer canceled the penultimate show in the tour in Glendale, Ariz. on Wednesday (Oct. 21) after telling fans that she had “completely lost” her voice .
